## Exact input

- `task` (select, required): Task
- `pdb` (textarea, required): Input antibody PDB
- `heavy_chain` (text, required): Heavy chain ID
- `light_chain` (text, optional): Light chain ID
- `include_antigen` (checkbox, optional): Include antigen context
- `antigen_chain` (text, optional): Antigen chain ID
- `regions` (json_editor, required): Regions to mutate
- `select_custom_residues` (checkbox, optional): Select custom residues
- `custom_heavy_residues` (text, optional): Custom heavy residues
- `custom_light_residues` (text, optional): Custom light residues
- `verify_sequences` (select, optional): Verify sequences
- `num_sequences` (number, optional; bounds 1..1000): Number of sequences
- `temperature` (number, optional; bounds 0..1): Temperature
- `num_batches` (number, optional; bounds 1..1000): Batches
